scope_limits: Additional working hours do not imply pay, entitlement, a legal rate or authority to assign work.
Breaks remain distinct from damaged objects, nonworking links, pagination and break-even analysis.
Attendance presence, documents, expected participation and numbers present remain distinct.
Person free time stays distinct from resource availability and technical uptime.
Software, record and configuration changes do not automatically become current-information reports; three expression contexts and the related policy-update term retain ambiguity.
Invitation requests, calendar artifacts, meeting-topic lists and reminders remain distinct from access authority, acceptance of requests and operational instructions.
Medication reminders and qualified deadlines retain complete-term identities and every specialist gate.
